title: connect / session / version
observations: doctor: connected=true, versionMatch=true, resultChannel=true, bridgeVersion=4.1.78.34f5b8d9, exit 0.
open --headless returns a sessionId in about 1 s, but the project keeps loading afterwards: polling getCurrentProjectInfo() needed ~3.9 s.
getReadyState() still returned 'notLoaded' after getCurrentProjectInfo() already returned the full project tree, so it cannot be used as a load gate.
There was exactly one origin=user session before and after the run; this spike only drove origin=cli sessions opened by itself.
A bare headless editor exposes 0 installed extensions; the fixture session exposes 3 (eext-common, zsxedahelper, dix) and none of them is the A connector.
open --path with a non-existent project path returns ok:true with a sessionId but creates/loads no project; ok:true is a transport-level statement.
risks: ok:true/exit 0 only means the call ran, not that the business state is correct
a CLI-opened window leaks unless session close --destroy is used
CLI sessions are half-offline by design (isHalfOfflineMode=true), not a full-online acceptance
PowerShell cannot capture this program's stdout with $x = & ... or > file; pipes/Start-Process are required
